internalNote: Built from Kevin's own per-song extraction CSV (kentucky_harmonist_1818_tunes.csv), 138 songs, pages 18-125 (pages 1-17 are this book's own front matter - rules and principles of composition, per the title page - with no song data to extract). First lines added in a follow-up upload (kentucky_harmonist_1818_tunes__1_.csv) - the original extraction didn't include them; this pass added firstLine to all 138 songs with no other field changes, confirmed by a full field-by-field diff before applying. No index cross-check has been done against this book's own printed index yet, unlike the multi-round verification done for some other Level 3 files this session - this remains a first-pass build from the extraction CSV alone.
